# MegaScenes

Images, videos, voice-overs and music from 140+ models (Veo, Kling, Seedance, Nano Banana, ElevenLabs) in one place, with the exact price before every run. Generated in your MegaScenes account.

## What it does
Ask Claude for an image, a clip, a voice-over or a track. It finds a model that fits, tells you the price in credits, and runs it in your MegaScenes account when you say so. Results land in your library; an image made here can be animated or upscaled in the next step.

**How the files are made:** images, clips, voice-overs and music are generated by more than a hundred image, video and audio models that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Inputs are text and files already in your MegaScenes library; Claude cannot pass your own attachments to the server.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install megascenes@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- MegaScenes talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Every run uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it starts; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- Results play or show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `search_models` | Search the catalog by kind and capability. Read-only. |
| `get_model` | Settings and prices of one model. Read-only. |
| `estimate_cost` | Exact price before running. Read-only. |
| `generate_media` | Starts one run in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_generation` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `list_generations` | Your recent runs and their files. Read-only. |
| `cancel_generation` | Cancels a running job; refunded when nothing was produced. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Make a 9:16 clip of a neon city in the rain with Kling, tell me the price first"
- "Create a product shot of a ceramic mug on a marble table, 4:5"
- "Turn this paragraph into a warm British narration"

## Data and privacy
Your prompts, the settings you choose and the library files you pass goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
